description: Change the active document's print settings (File > Print) without the dialog: printer, copies, colour handling (including separations), print space, rendering intent, black point compensation, hard proof, position and scale, printing marks, functions (emulsion down, negative, background, border, bleed) and PostScript options. Only the settings given change

background.description: Functions: page background colour. "#RRGGBB", "rgb(r,g,b)" (0-255), "cmyk(c,m,y,k)" (0-100), "gray(g)" (0-100, 100 = black), "hsb(h,s,b)" (0-360, 0-100, 0-100) or "lab(L,a,b)"

colorHandling.description: Photoshop manages colours, the printer manages colours, or print each channel as a separation

description.description: Printing marks: print the File Info description

hardProof.description: Print a hard proof that simulates the Proof Setup device

labels.description: Printing marks: print the document title

position.description: Position and scale on the page: centered, fit (scale to fit the media), or custom with x and y (pixels from the page's top-left) and scale (percent)

printSpace.description: Printer profile (print space) name; empty string for the same as the source

renderingIntent.description: Rendering intent when the print space differs from the source

name: set_print_options
title: Set Print Options
